description: Backup mirror of mVolt+, the NVIDIA GPU tuning and monitoring tool with voltage, clock, power and fan control, V/F curves, live telemetry and saved profiles.
notes: Same files as 'mvolt', downloaded from the AmirulAndalib/mvolt-scoop backup mirror instead of the upstream release. Install mvolt or mvolt-mirror, not both.
Tuning needs administrator rights. Profiles and settings live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\mVolt+ and are kept on update and uninstall.
Exit mVolt+ from the tray before updating.
post_install: $copies = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'mVolt+.exe' } | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ -PathType Leaf })
warn "Your Start with Windows copy of mVolt+ is still version $old. Open mVolt+ as administrator once to update it to $version, or run the Scoop update from an administrator terminal."
if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $copy -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $newHash) { throw 'hash check failed after copy' }
Write-Host "Updated the Start with Windows copy of mVolt+ from $old to $version."
warn "Could not update the Start with Windows copy of mVolt+ ($old): $($_.Exception.Message). Exit mVolt+ from the tray, then open it as administrator once."
pre_uninstall: warn 'mVolt+ Start with Windows is set up for this user. It runs its own copy from %ProgramFiles%\mVolt+ and keeps starting at logon after this uninstall. Turn Start with Windows off in mVolt+ if you no longer want it.'
